title: Disable Hidden Lod Connection Hitboxes
description: In flow minimap, overview, and compact LODs handles are not visible; creating connections by accidentally clicking on the connection hitbox should not work. Only normal LOD (input row hitbox) and detail/micro LOD (visible handles) should allow connection picking.
summary: Added `DagDrawLod::allows_connection_hit_picking()` (normal input-row hitbox + detail/micro visible handles only). DagHost now syncs `engine.handle_pointer_picking` per LOD and ignores invisible handle/row hits in `world_hits_handle`, so minimap/overview/compact clicks select nodes instead of starting wire drag. Regression test covers all three hidden LODs.
